setup_admin_intro: Create the instance administrator account. You can invite others afterwards.
setup_org_intro: Your organization's details, used on invoices, emails, and throughout the app.
setup_org_iban_hint: Optional. A Swiss QR-IBAN enables QR-bill invoicing.
setup_locales_intro: Choose which languages are active on this instance, and check email delivery.
setup_finish_seed_roles: Create the default roles (Admin, Board, Treasurer, Warehouse manager, Event manager, Volunteer, Read-only)
setup_finish_success: Setup complete. Sign in with the admin account you just created.
forgot_password_intro: Enter your email address — if it matches an account, you'll receive a link to reset your password.
forgot_password_sent: If that address matches an account, you'll receive an email shortly.
forgot_password_unavailable: Password reset by email isn't available on this instance. Contact an administrator.
reset_password_invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired.
reset_password_success: Password reset. You can now sign in.
invite_accept_intro_new: You've been invited to join {orgName}. Choose your name and a password to create your account.
invite_accept_intro_existing: Choose a new password for your account.
invite_accept_invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired, or has already been used.
users_invite_email: Email of the person to invite
users_invite_link_ready: No email provider configured: copy this link and send it yourself.
users_reset_password_result: Temporary password: {password} — share it with the person directly.
roles_system_locked: Default role: permissions can be edited, but it can't be deleted.
roles_delete_confirm_body: Users with this role will lose the permissions it grants.
twofactor_intro: Add an extra layer of security to your account with an authenticator app.
twofactor_scan_qr: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the generated code.
twofactor_backup_codes_intro: Keep these somewhere safe — each can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app.
email_invite_body: You've been invited to join {orgName} on Arnia. Use the link below to create your account.
email_reset_body: We received a request to reset your account's password. Use the link below to choose a new one. If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.
email_change_body: Use the link below to confirm the new email address for your Arnia account.
